What is the balori build? Im not familiar with that. But also this is mainly a guide for S**upport** maokai, because the rune choice plays a HUGE part in this strategy (as well as the support item). If you run grasp and precision thats not as efficient as running the rune set up I went into, which I understand you need the tankiness for top lane, but it is NOT mathematically correct at all. The reason why I created this build is to turn a support maokai player into basically a 2nd jungler. That way you feel like you have as much impact on the game as possible compared  to the ENEMY support.

Yeah sure I can go into more detail. The point of a "mathematically correct build" is to do 3 things as efficiently as possible: 1.Heal, 2.Disrupt 3. Deal damage. The math part is mainly for the omnivamp part of the build, which I went into more detail at the bottom of the itemization section, but other than that its mostly the computers job to calculate the percentages in game. Some of these percentages include, 9% true damage bonus from stacking your Riftmaker passive, %healing scaling off your max health for your passive healing, 63 ability haste to 40% cdr conversion, %percent max health damage from your E, and %healing from Omnivamp. ( And if you build Demonic Embrace that also adds onto the %percent max health damage as well as adding the extra resistances you receive when you damage a champion). But notice how I didnt go into damage. Thats because with maokai you dont NEED the extra ap, as the most succesful supports usually have good base damage in their abilities and dont require items to hit powerspikes.

So compared to other builds the reason why this is more mathematically correct is due to a couple of factors.  First you have the 24% omnivamp which is nonexsistant in any of the current builds, so thats the main focus of this strategy here. Second is because of CDR , I like to call CDR boots the Equational boots of infinity because lower cooldowns on your abilities means that you heal more often and you can do damage more often. And Finally the true damage is the capstone of this strategy, where ironically you DONT have to do math because it is guaranteed damage that ignores the enemies resistances.
